question: As per the Union Budget 2025-26, what is the revised FDI limit for the insurance sector?
solution:
The correct answer is __**100%**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Union Budget 2025-26 introduced key reforms to strengthen the financial sector.
 
• The FDI limit for the insurance sector has been increased from 74% to 100%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) limit in the insurance sector has been raised from 74% to 100% to attract more capital inflow.
 
• A forum for regulatory coordination and the development of pension products will be established.
 
• The government will roll out a revamped Central KYC Registry in 2025 to simplify the KYC (Know Your Customer) process.
 
• These measures aim to improve financial accessibility, enhance investment, and ensure a more integrated financial system.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Union Budget__

 __
 
• A budget is an elaborate statement of the expenditure and income of the government for the given financial year, which begins on April 1 and ends on March 31.
 
• The Constitution uses the term **Annual Financial Statement** instead of "Budget," as enshrined under **Article 112** of the Constitution.
 
 
 
• Foreign Direct Investment (FDI)__
 __
 
• FDI is when foreign investors invest in a country's businesses, typically with ownership control.
 
• The insurance sector's FDI cap has been progressively raised from 26% (2000) to 49% (2015), then to 74% (2021), and now 100% (2025-26).
 
 
 
• Know Your Customer (KYC)__
 __
 
• KYC is a process used by banks and financial institutions to verify the identity of customers.
 
• The revamped Central KYC Registry will help streamline and digitize customer verification across financial entities.
 
 
 
• Pension Sector Reforms__
 
 
• A regulatory forum will be created to oversee pension product development.
 
• The goal is to expand access to retirement savings options and enhance financial security for citizens.
